column1: # Partition table for env:esp32dev_ILI9341_wad and every container-reading build
# (D3.10; the layout D0.5 wrote down and D3.10 repartitioned).
# The demo's own copy of the table. The bench keeps its own file because it is a
# separate PlatformIO project; this copy exists so the DOOM project never depends
# on a directory it does not own. One layout
# layout has to be made in both places.
#   nvs       0x009000 .. 0x00F000        24 KB  (unchanged; the bootloader's)
#   wad       0x100000 .. 0x400000         3 MB  the mmap'd PWHD container
# WHY 960 KB OF APP AND 3 MB OF CONTAINER
# D3.8 measured the shipped image at 356
column3: and the slot it sat in was

column2: 984 KB. The whole shareware episode needs a 1.5 MB union bake plus 848 KB of

column1: # raw map lumps
column2: which the 2 MB container slot could not hold. Moving 1 MB from

column1: # the app to the container is what makes the episode fit; the image keeps 626 KB
# of headroom in the new slot (63.7 %)
column2: which is the room Phases 4-6 grow into.

column1: # The split is 960 KB
# puts the container on exactly 3 MiB (0x300000) and the table ends exactly at
# 0x400000. Every offset and size in the app and wad rows is 64 KB aligned
# the only unaligned row is `nvs`
column2: whose 0x9000 offset the bootloader fixes and

column1: # which this task does not touch.
# There is deliberately no OTA and no spiffs slot: a 4 MB part cannot carry a
# second app image and the container at the same time
# reason this table exists. No `phy_init` row is present either: this IDF version
# (Arduino-ESP32 4.2 / IDF 4.4) does not require one for Wi-Fi PHY calibration --
# the previous table shipped without it and booted
column2: and the change is scoped to

column1: # the app/container split.
# Subtype 0x40 is the first custom data subtype. WhdSource finds the partition
# by label
column2: so the number only has to be unique in this table. The container is

column1: # flashed at 0x100000; see tools/make_container.ps1 for the exact command.
# Name
nvs
factory
wad
